body: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
plain_description: **Optimize and deploy AI models across a range of devices, from edge to cloud.** Use models built with popular machine learning frameworks. Run inference on CPUs, Intel GPUs, and Intel NPUs.
technical_description: Open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models. It supports model conversion and inference with models from PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, TensorFlow Lite, PaddlePaddle, and JAX/Flax, and provides C++, Python, C, and Node.js APIs. The README describes CPU, Intel GPU, and Intel NPU inference, plus generative AI pipelines.
title: OpenVINO
